program.name: Push Pull
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Two days on repeat: everything that pushes, then everything that pulls, legs shared between them.
program.about: The simplest split there is: a push day and a pull day, on repeat. Push days are presses, squats and triceps; pull days are rows, hinges and biceps, so each muscle rests a full day between. Straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
